title: Every GTA 6 Actor Rumored and Confirmed by Rockstar Ahead of Launch
summary: Rockstar hasn't confirmed anything, but online detectives are on the case

News Rockstar hasn't confirmed anything, but online detectives are on the case Every GTA 6 actor rumored and confirmed ahead of launch Image: Rockstar Games Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Grand Theft Auto 6 Sign in to your Polygon.com account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap It's been an excruciatingly long wait, but we're just days away from the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 . Ahead of the game's launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, Rockstar Games has yet to reveal any official details about the actors who will appear in GTA 6 , including the central couple, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Even so, eagle-eyed fans on social media have been speculating for months about who's playing the lead duo, as well as prominent supporting characters featured in trailers, previews, and promotional materials, including Brian Heder, Cal Hampton, Raul Bautista, and Boobie Ike. While we wait for Rockstar to make it official, we've rounded up all the most credible rumors about the GTA 6 cast below. Lucia Caminos GTA 6 casting rumors Grand Theft Auto 6 Image: Rockstar Games Manni L. Perez has been rumored to be playing the female lead in GTA 6 for three years now , since Rockstar shared its first trailer for the game. Over on the game's subreddit, you'll find dozens of posts about her from over the years, often comparing her appearance to that of the in-game character. (There is, indeed, a striking resemblance.) Perez has previously appeared in Law and Order: SVU, Chicago P.D., and Jessica Jones . She also provided the voice for a nightclub patron and a blackjack dealer in GTA Online . Neither Perez nor Rockstar have confirmed her involvement in the project. Jason Duval GTA 6 casting rumors The character Jason Duval is shown in a scene from the forthcoming Grand Theft Auto 6. Image: Rockstar Games The male lead of GTA 6 is widely rumored to be portrayed by actor Dylan Rourke. He has previously appeared in one episode each of Grey’s Anatomy and Modern Family . A number of YouTube videos have compared Jason's dialogue with some of Rourke's previous work. Though the two sound quite similar, neither Rourke nor Rockstar have confirmed his involvement in the project. Brian Heder GTA 6 casting rumors Image: Rockstar Games Back in September, Emmy-winning actor Stephen Root confirmed longstanding rumors he would be playing Brian in GTA 6 during a red-carpet interview with the Associated Press. "Yeah, you’re going to see me in there,” he said. “I think from the first rollout of GTA that they were doing almost a year ago they had my character in there, and there were too many people that knew me from King of the Hill and my voice. So, I think that secret kind of got divulged then.” Rockstar Games has not yet confirmed that Root will be playing Brian. Cal Hampton GTA 6 casting rumors Image: Grant Walkup / Polygon For several months, fans have speculated that Saturday Night Live alum Bobby Moynihan will be playing Cal Hampton, a chill friend of Jason Duval who never met a conspiracy theory he didn't like. On social media , fans have highlighted the physical resemblance between the actor and the character, Moynihan's previous experience with motion capture work, and the fact that he recently started following Dylan Rourke as evidence in favor of his casting. Neither Moynihan nor Rockstar have confirmed his involvement in the project. Raul Bautista GTA 6 casting rumors Raul Batista Talks on His Phone in Grand Theft Auto 6 Image: Rockstar Games The GTA fandom is less certain about who is playing Raul Bautista, an older mentor to Jason and Lucia who featured prominently in Netflix's Extended Look back in August. Several netizens honed in on the actor's Dominican accent, leading them to speculate the character was being played by actor Manny Perez, known for his roles in independent films and TV shows like Blue Bloods and Law and Order: SVU . Other online rumor-mongers claim he will be played by Spanish actor Óscar Jaenada, who shared an Instagram post that appears to show him wearing a T-shirt with a picture of Raul. Rockstar Games has not confirmed whether either actor will appear in GTA 6 . Boobie Ike GTA 6 casting rumors Image: Rockstar Games Of all the GTA 6 characters that Rockstar has revealed so far, Boobie Ike is the biggest mystery of the bunch. The game's official site describes him as "one of the few to transform his time in the streets into a legitimate empire spanning real estate, a strip club, and a recording studio — Boobie's all smiles until it's time to talk business." However, the character has yet to appear in a single trailer. Jason and Lucia were working for Boobie during the drug deal gone wrong at the start of the Netflix Extended Look, but the character didn't appear in that preview, either. That means we still don't know what he sounds like, which has made it difficult for the fandom to reach a consensus on who's playing the character. (That hasn't stopped redditors from making some wild speculation about T-Pain and Kanye West , though.) Some folks on social media think Boobie could be played by actor Johnny Ray Gill due to a cryptic social media post he made hinting at an upcoming project, but there's not much meat on that bone. Rockstar Games has not confirmed who will play Boobie Ike in GTA 6 . Polygon Interactive Switch Wheel Gaming • Quizzes • Grand Theft Auto Michael Franklin Trevor Lester Lamar Polygon Quiz W h i c h G T A V C h a r a c t e r A r e Y o u ? 8 Questions • 5 Characters Set aside what any of them do for a living. Underneath, Los Santos runs on five very different people: one restless, one patient, one with no filter, one who has already worked out how it ends, and one who has never once doubted himself. Eight ordinary questions, none of them about the job, will say which one you are. On The Wheel Michael Franklin Trevor Lester Lamar Spin The Wheel Block 01 of 08 0% Driven Question 01 A NEW CITY 01 You move somewhere new. What does your first week look like? Everybody arrives differently. A I picked the house first. Everything else arranges itself around that. B Working, learning the place, watching who does well here and how. C Introducing myself to everybody, loudly, inside about an hour. D I researched it for six months. I know it better than people who live there. E Telling everyone back home how well it is going before it is going at all. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 02 of 08 12% Driven Question 02 THE CAR 02 What are you driving, and what is playing in it? Be honest. This one is very revealing. A Something comfortable and sensible that I am quietly embarrassed by. B Something I worked for, kept clean, and I know exactly what it cost me. C Whatever was nearest, at a volume nobody in the area asked for. D I do not drive. I would rather not be out there at all. E Something louder than I can afford, and I will tell you what it is worth. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 03 of 08 25% Driven Question 03 THE CREDIT 03 Somebody takes credit for your work in a meeting. Eight seconds to decide what kind of person you are. A I let it go, and then feel worse about it for a week. B I say nothing, and I remember exactly who was in the room. C I say precisely what I think about it, at length, right then. D I already have a record of who did what. It will come up later. E I laugh, take a bit of their credit back, and we move on. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 04 of 08 38% Driven Question 04 THE DINNER 04 A family dinner is going badly. Where are you in it? Everybody has been at this dinner. A Paying for it, and wondering how it ended up like this. B Quiet. Watching. Working out when I can reasonably leave. C I am the reason it is going badly and I am having a lovely time. D I did not come. I was invited, and I did not come. E Talking the whole way through it, and genuinely lifting the mood. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 05 of 08 50% Driven Question 05 MONEY 05 A large amount of money lands in your lap. What happens to it? Nobody answers this the way they think they will. A A bigger house and a worse mood. B Invested, carefully, in the thing that gets me out. C Gone by Thursday and I could not tell you where. D Moved somewhere safe before anybody knows I have it. E Spent on something visible, immediately, so that everybody knows. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 06 of 08 62% Driven Question 06 THE PHONE 06 Your phone rings at the worst possible moment. Who is it, and do you pick up? A My kids. I let it ring, and then I feel terrible about it. B Somebody who needs something. I pick up, because I said I would. C Does not matter who. I am answering and they are not getting a word in. D I screen everything. I will call back when I am ready. E It is me calling them, and it is the fourth time today. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 07 of 08 75% Driven Question 07 THE MISREAD 07 What do people most often get wrong about you? The gap between how you read and how you are. A They think I have it all worked out. B They think this is as far as I am going. C They think I do not know exactly what I am doing. D They think I am not paying attention. E They think I do not mean a word of it. ← Back Pick one, then Next Next Question Block 08 of 08 88% Driven Question 08 TEN YEARS ON 08 Ten years from now. Where are you? This is the one that decides it. A Trying to retire for the fourth time. B Out. Properly out, and it took exactly this long. C Exactly where I am now, and completely fine about it. D Somewhere quiet with a very good internet connection. E Three ideas in, and the next one is definitely the one. ← Back Pick one, then Next Switch To Me The Wheel Stops You Are These are temperaments, not resumes. Your answers keep landing on the same one, and it is rarely the one people expect of themselves. here --> Los Santos / Retired Michael Comfort / Restlessness / Regret You got everything and it did not help. Comfortable, restless, and quietly furious about being both. You bought the house, you got the life, and you have spent every year since wondering what it was supposed to be for. Why That Is You Michael is the only one of the five who is already successful when you meet him, which makes him the only one whose real problem is boredom. You picked the house first, and the rest of your life arranged itself around that one decision. A bad family dinner is one you are paying for, while wondering how it ended up like this. Ten years on you are trying to retire for the fourth time, and you will not manage it. Comfortable Restless Paying For It here --> Los Santos / Ambitious Franklin Ambition / Patience / Getting Out You are the only one with a plan to leave. Patient where the others are not, watchful where the others are loud, and the only one in Los Santos treating any of this as a route to somewhere better. Why That Is You Franklin is the one who arrives wanting out, and everything he does is measured against whether it moves him closer to that. You say nothing when somebody takes credit for your work, and you remember exactly who was in the room. Money gets invested carefully in the thing that gets you out, which nobody else here would even consider. People think this is as far as you are going. That is the single most useful thing they could believe. Patient Watchful Getting Out here --> Sandy Shores / Unfiltered Trevor No Filter / No Plan / Total Loyalty You say the thing everyone else is thinking. No filter, no plan, and no interest in pretending otherwise. You are the loudest person in any room by a distance, and the most loyal one in it by a wider distance than that. Why That Is You Trevor is the least predictable character in the game and the most quoted, because he says out loud what everybody else is being careful about. You introduce yourself to everyone, loudly, within an hour of arriving anywhere. Money is gone by Thursday and you genuinely could not tell anybody where it went. People think you do not know exactly what you are doing. You do, and that is the unsettling part. No Filter Unpredictable Fiercely Loyal here --> Los Santos / Calculating Lester Planning / Caution / Knowing Everything You worked out how it ends before it started. You do not go out, you do not improvise, and you have known the answer for a while. Everybody else is reacting. You are the only one who has read ahead. Why That Is You Lester is the one who sees the whole board, and he is written as the opposite of everybody around him: no volume, no impulse, all preparation. You researched the place for six months before you moved, and you know it better than people who grew up there. You screen every call and ring back when you are ready, which other people find rude and you find obvious. People think you are not paying attention. You have a record of exactly who did what, and it will come up. Prepared Screens Calls Reads Ahead here --> Los Santos / Relentless Lamar Confidence / Schemes / Never Doubts It You have never once doubted yourself. Relentless, funny and completely unbothered by the last four ideas not working. You are the reason the room is in a good mood, and the next one is definitely the one. Why That Is You Lamar is the character with the most confidence and the least evidence, and the game clearly likes him more for it. You told everyone back home how well it was going well before it was going at all. Money goes on something visible, immediately, because what is the point otherwise. People think you do not mean a word of it. You mean all of it, every time, which is why the next one is definitely the one. Confident Funny Next One's The One Closest Matches 1 • • • 0% 2 • • • 0% 3 • • • 0% Retune Copy Result Copied A Polygon Interactive Polygon More quizzes at polygon.com Past Rockstar Games casts Image: Grove Street Games/Rockstar Games In past GTA installments, Rockstar looked to well-known movie and TV actors to fill out the cast. 2002's Grand Theft Auto: Vice City included a number of big names, including Ray Liotta, Tom Sizemore, Dennis Hopper, Danny Trejo, Debbie Harry, and Jenna Jameson. In 2004, Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas starred Ice-T, Samuel L. Jackson, James Woods, Charlie Murphy, and David Cross, among many others. A longstanding (but unconfirmed) rumor claims that Liotta might have reprized his role as the Hawaiian shirt-loving protagonist Tommy Vercetti in San Andreas , but he asked for more money than Rockstar was willing to pay. Instead, the cast of GTA 6 bears a closer resemblance to that of GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2: less widely known, yet very accomplished voice actors who are less likely to demand a massive payout. Still, given the stratospheric levels of hype surrounding Rockstar's latest, we suspect these new cast members are about to become household names.
